clos.loDetails: Understand Cultural Influences on different Communication Contexts including business, education and health care context; the challenges of intercultural comminucation.
Understand the relationship between Communication and Culture and their elements;
Recognize the Deep Structure of Culture: Lessons from the Family;
Understand Cultural History of different countries/ religions;
Understand the Cultural Explanations of Life and Death; concepts related religions and some popular religions in the world;
Identify Cultural Values and apply some Guidelines for Behavior
Understand the concepts and relationship between culture and identity;
Deepy understand and apply verbal language in communication;
Deepy understand and apply non-verbal language in communication;

assessments.questionType: Each student chooses one sub-topic related to the contents covered in the course and write about it. The assignment is supposed to be 1000-1500 words long.

assessments.note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.

assessments.duration:
30' 
(20 mins to present and 10 mins for Q & A)
assessments.questionType: The whole class is divided into groups. Each group is assigned to choose one topic related to the contents covered in the textbook and present about it in 20 minutes, 10 mins for Q & A.
assessments.knowledgeSkill:
Based on topics of studied units

(Suggestions: greeting custom, wedding customs, social etiquete, Issues of Belonging, guesture interpretation, etc)
assessments.note: The mark will be given based on each student's performance, not on the whole group's. It means each student will get his own mark.
